name: Ilse Brant
bio: Came off Ridgeward haulage, where the trick was never being where the road wanted you. She has not stopped doing it.

personality.label: Restless road-runner
personality.description: Trusts movement more than armour. Sharp-tongued when anyone asks her to sit still.

move: Already looking for the next turn.
Road wants me there? I will take the other line.
attack: Passing through. Leaving a few holes.
Keep them turning. I have the angle.
hold_fire: Quiet guns, moving feet. Works for me.
investigate: I will take the long way round and have a look.
heavy_fire: Too much landing on me. I need room to move.
They have my line. A new route would be lovely.
